text:
lina: quick heads up — PR #47512 touches runtime batching and KV cache eviction thresholds. Need quick eyes from runtime, eng-infra, and security (KMS path). Planning canary Wed 09:00 PT. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/47512
dan: pinging @sasha @mike for runtime perf and infra implications. Is this safe for a rolling canary?

sasha: @lina can you paste the small config diff? quick skim only, not a full review

lina: sure — main change is trimming batches when queue_time > 120ms and reducing kv_eviction_threshold from 0.75 -> 0.65. snippet:

```
# runtime config
batcher:
  max_batch_ms: 100
  trim_threshold_ms: 120
kv_cache:
  eviction_threshold: 0.65
  min_idle_seconds: 30
```

lina: also adds a fast-path for tiny requests to bypass batching if batch_size == 1. No model weights change.

mike: looks small. runtime perf ok but we should watch tail latency in canary. Can we enable per-instance tracing for that window? @eng-sre?

anna_sec: quick Q — does this change KMS/secret access? any new key usage? If not, we should be fine. If yes, need a quick KMS review.

lina: no new KMS calls; uses same key for cache encryption. Only config. Will add note in PR.

infra-bot: CI passed — 12 tests, 0 failures. deploy-preview available at https://deploy-preview.example/redwood/47512

dan: can someone LGTM so I can schedule canary slot? Prefer Tue or Wed morning (US) — we have a maintenance window Wed 09:00-11:00 PT.

sasha: i'll do a quick run tomorrow morning. if infra is ok, LGTM from runtime.

mike: ack. will monitor canary and set an alert on 95th pct token latency.

lina: thanks all. I'll tag runtime/infrastructure owners in PR and bump canary to Wed 09:00 PT. Leaving open for last comments :thumbsup:

anna_sec: :ok_hand:
